title: The greasy leather orb flew like a heavy bird
html_source: Soccer—or, as Europeans call it, football—was a very popular sport in Ireland at the time as the sport was growing all over the world. “The greasy leather orb” refers to the ball itself: soccer balls were made of full grain leather as opposed to the synthetic material used today.
